chapterTitle: The Righteous Strategy: Occupy the Moral High Ground
coreMove: Gain structural advantage by being read as the just side under observation, through conduct the audience can defend and framing the audience can recognize.
reversal: A single exposed hypocrisy can collapse the posture almost instantly because moral advantage depends on consistency more than performance.
teachingEmphasis: treat legitimacy as a structural advantage under observation
show how public framing depends on real conduct underneath it
avoid romanticizing moral theater or audience manipulation
